notes.title: VMM SNR Analysis — P2 Basket Detector
notes.description: Signal-to-noise analysis of the VMM3a configuration scan on the P2 BASKET detector: sweeping gain (sg) and peaking time (snt) over paired signal/noise runs to find the SNR-optimal configuration.

notes.title: VMM Trigger Rate Analysis — P2 Basket Detector
notes.description: The five-step trigger-rate pipeline applied to the VMM3a configuration scan at 5 kHz and 15 kHz beam intensity, illustrated step by step on VMM 11 and VMM 12.

notes.title: Triangle Geometry Check — P2 Basket FEM
notes.description: Geometry and boundary-condition check of the triangle reference model: 625.2 mm side, 1693 cm² active area, 18 597 pillar centres at 3 mm pitch and the 1 mm wall border.

notes.title: Triangle FEM — Uz surface
notes.description: Out-of-plane displacement surface of the equilateral-triangle reference geometry (area 169 256 mm², E = 1 GPa, t = 0.5 mm, 3 mm pillar pitch).

notes.title: P2 Basket — buckling geometry and BC check
notes.description: Boundary-condition zone map behind the baking-buckling sweep: wall spring, pillar snap and free interior node counts, read straight from the tension-sweep CSVs.

notes.title: P2 Basket — Baking Buckling Analysis
notes.description: Will the mesh buckle during the 25 → 146 °C bake? Analytical eigenvalue sweep over 300–1000 N/m — the threshold sits at ~121 N/m (1.2 N/cm), well below the tested range, matching the experiment.

notes.title: P2 Basket FEM Tension Sweep — without pillars
notes.description: The same 3–10 N/cm sweep with the pillar support removed: displacement runs to tens of millimetres, far past the 50 µm planarity threshold — the reference case for what the pillars carry.

notes.title: P2 Basket FEM Tension Sweep — with pillars
notes.description: CalculiX tension sweep 3–10 N/cm of the v4 basket model with the pillar lattice: out-of-plane displacement 16–32 µm and von Mises stress against the 50 µm planarity threshold.

notes.title: P2 Basket FEM Comparison Report
notes.description: Three mesh strategies at T = 1000 N/m: the basket adaptive FreeCAD mesh gives 31.96 µm with an artefact peak, the identical geometry on a uniform Gmsh mesh gives 1.57 µm — a 20× difference from mesh quality alone.

notes.title: Basket vs Triangle — Uz comparison
notes.description: Out-of-plane displacement of the P2 basket polygon against an equal-area equilateral triangle, same Gmsh C3D10 mesh settings and a shared colour scale per tension step.

notes.title: P2 Basket — geometry verification
notes.description: Layer-stack verification of the v4 basket model against the sweep target — PCB substrate, 128 µm amplification gap and 500 µm mesh layer — over 102 407 nodes.

notes.title: P2 Basket Bulk Micromegas — FEM Technical Report
notes.description: FEM technical report: field and gain studies of the P2 basket bulk Micromegas with pillars (interactive Plotly figures).
